manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Extract the prompts shown on screen in a video by OCRing it frame by frame, merging scrolled and repeated views into one entry each, so prompts demoed in a screen recording do not have to be transcribed by hand.
manifest.name: @kody-w/prompt_extractor

all_text.description: Return every text block, not just prompt-like ones

fps.description: Frames sampled per second (default 1.0; 0.5 is faster, 2 catches quick cuts)

min_score.description: Prompt-likeness threshold, default 2.0. Lower to catch more.

save_to.description: Optional path to write the full markdown result

url.description: Video URL or local file path
